meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of facts read from law firms' own public websites and from official open registries on the dates shown, kept for research and marketing planning. Each row's coverage says how much of the market it reaches. The counts describe what websites and registries say, not the quality of any firm or lawyer. A firm can ask us to correct its row or to be left out through the data corrections page; we act within 7 days.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.title: Version 3.2.1
changes.summary: Same read and the same counts of firms. 99,916 firms are listed by name in the row files and on the /firms/ pages. A name that is only one person's name is counted and not listed. So is a firm whose name or website name contains a phone-shaped number (a toll-free number written in letters included), a street-address shape, the end of a postal address or a PO box, and a page address that contains one is not linked. Every firm counts in the figures.

changes.title: Version 3.2.0
changes.summary: Read up to 2026-11-09: 129,974 law firms found in 51 of the 51 jurisdictions (77,971 with a website read, 52,003 from official registries only), from 1,129,411 of the 1,129,428 candidate sites checked. 6 of the 51 jurisdictions are a registry list; the others are samples.

changes.title: Version 3.1.0
changes.summary: Rows that are not law firms left the counts and files (domain-sale pages, bar bodies, government offices, businesses that serve lawyers, unrelated businesses, mailing-address rows), and one website is now one row: the census holds 60,206 law firms in 51 of the 51 jurisdictions (6,060 with a website read, 54,146 from official registries only), read up to 2026-10-28.

changes.title: Version 3.0.0
changes.summary: The data holds 4,554 records. 23 columns (such as county and share_spanish) are now in firm-web-census-values.csv, as id, column and value rows; join it to firm-web-census.csv on id.

Version 2.0.0, read up to 2026-10-28: 61,694 law firms found in 51 of the 51 jurisdictions (6,540 with a website read, 55,154 from official registries only); aggregates CC BY 4.0, firm rows ODbL files.
